summary: Create a cute, book-aesthetic anniversary website celebrating the user's 1st year relationship, personalized for VEERA.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Cute storybook-style book cover illustration with hearts/flowers and a warm cream/tan palette (anniversary-cover.dim_1600x900.png)
- Seamless subtle paper texture background, warm off-white with light grain (paper-texture.dim_2048x2048.png)
- Set of 6 small cute doodle icons in the same style (heart, flower, star, ribbon, bookmark, sparkle) on transparent background (doodles-set.dim_1024x1024.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-page anniversary website that celebrates the user's 1st completed year of relationship and explicitly includes the name “VEERA” in the hero message.
Implement a book-inspired UI layout: a ‘cover’ section and multiple ‘pages’ that the user can navigate through (e.g., next/previous buttons or page indicators), with a cute aesthetic.

Add a coherent visual theme and styling system consistent across the site (colors, typography, spacing, components) that matches a cute, cozy, book/paper aesthetic (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).
Include lightweight decorative visuals (e.g., book cover illustration, subtle paper texture background, small doodle icons) as static assets and use them in the UI.
